info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employee Evaluations API
info.description: The Employee Evaluations API facilitates the submission and management of employee performance evaluations within an organization. This API allows HR professionals to initiate the evaluation process, ensuring that employee performance is accurately assessed and documented. Typical consumers include HR departments and management teams who utilize the API to align performance reviews with company standards and improve workforce development. By streamlining the evaluation process, organizations can enhance employee engagement and support overall talent management strategies.

post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of a new evaluation for an employee, capturing relevant metrics and feedback to support performance assessments within the human resource management system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit employee evaluation data for processing. It should contain relevant evaluation metrics along with employee identifiers to ensure accurate record-keeping and analysis.

200.description: The employee evaluation was successfully submitted.
